title: "Family Reunion"
subtitle: "The call for slaughter has sounded, unleash the hounds of war!"

trails.title: Old Debts Unsettled
trails.description: Some things have been lost for too long, and recovering them is now a luxury.

content.text:
※1917.▊▊.▊▊, confirmed that Mata Hari still has a sister on the run, but her whereabouts remain unknown. A bounty has been issued through the Hunter's Guild.

...

※1985.▊▊.▊▊, confirmed that the fugitive Mata Hari sisters are involved in espionage and assassination activities, Code name: Kimberly. Personnel have been dispatched for containment. Use force if necessary.

※1985.▊▊.▊▊, Ms. Kimberly's contract item has been recovered without any expected conflict. The original contractor has been handed over to local government authorities, and the contract item will be sent to headquarters for permanent storage.

...

※199?.▊▊.▊▊, due to secondary incidents caused by the "Storm," the contract item was lost during an accident. A high-priority standing order has been issued—any field personnel who come across Ms. Kimberly's contract item must immediately recover it. If it is confirmed that Ms. Kimberly's seal has been broken, ensure personal safety and contact headquarters to assist the special agent in resealing.

...

※10-1990.▊▊.▊▊, Ms. Kimberly was found in San Francisco. Zeno has been tasked with searching for and sealing her.

※10-1990.▊▊.▊▊, Admiral Igor reported back that the contract item has been recovered, and preparations for containment are underway.

items.text: "Family Reunion"
Igor's Office
After a long wait, father and daughter reconvene.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Father, Ptolemy and the unit have arrived.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Huh. So here they are. The "army of justice" ready to eradicate the Manus and the deserters in one fell swoop.
He picks up a gift he received from the Foundation.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: During the last "Storm," the Foundation created this thing.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: And with the help of Laplace and the Apeiron arcanists, they stole the fire of the gods, just like Prometheus.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Which side would you choose?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: I wouldn't. I would follow.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Follow you wherever you lead.
Her loyalty is like a shield to protect herself from her inner doubt.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Send someone to bring Stefen's belongings here.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: That traitor found something important at Tuesday's Motel.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Ptolemy will find it useful.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: That's all for now.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Understood.
Zeno Base

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Moldir! Long time no see!
The one-eyed officer steps forward to embrace his older sister, kissing her on both cheeks.
The conversation gets straight to the point.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: What do you say? Do we give those humans a chance to surrender?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: *sigh* Manus Vindictae don't accept humans.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: But I doubt Father would blame you if your men allowed them to escape the base.
A hint.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Escape the base? Haha, Moldir, are you having second thoughts?
He sneers at his sister's "kindness."

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Either follow this path to the very end, or show mercy and get Father and the two of us executed.
He shouts a few orders to his officers, instructing them to return to their respective units and await the admiral's command.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: So what, then? You want to have a mass execution like Lopera did? On what charges? For refusing to join the rebellion? Disobeying orders?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Oh, no, there'll be no trials.
He leans in close and whispers a few words in his sister's ear.
Moldir's eyes widen.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: All my men know about this plan. We're just waiting for Father's orders.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: They all know?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Well, those who're still alive.
Only blood and dirt can bury secrets.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: The Manus have provided us with a miracle that allows us to survive the "Storm." How could anyone refuse such a sacred gift?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Even after the total destruction caused by the vacuum bomb, we still detected life signs.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: No one in history has ever been able to do that. Lady Arcana is invincible.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: I don't care about Arcana. What worries me is that the soldiers who are unwilling to follow us won't just surrender.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Then we shoot them.
His delivery is disturbingly casual.
There are only two options: follow or die.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: I don't think that's—
The admiral strides toward them.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Oh, Father!

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Where are the others?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: They went to rally the soldiers. We've been waiting for this day for ages!
He seems to have known about the admiral's plan for quite some time.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: For ages? How long have you known about this?
She looks at Ptolemy, confusion and astonishment in her eyes.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: I told your siblings some time ago.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Then Lopera ...

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: She's not part of the plan. Her only responsibility is to bring back Dores.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Dores? Who's that?

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: None of your concern.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: You have other things to worry about. Go issue your orders to your soldiers.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Moldir, prepare the aircraft. We're going to Tierra del Fuego.
All the way to the southernmost tip of the continent. To a place where he can gaze upon that snow-capped land to the south and feel the icy breeze on his face once again.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: How many of our soldiers do you think will remain loyal?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: I'd say about eighty percent. The arcanists will follow us, there's no doubt about that, but we still have a lot of human soldiers. Don't worry. I'll be sure to deal with them.
A necessary sacrifice.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: The spilling of blood will only unite us further.
A betrayal of their brotherhood. But there will be no escape once blood is spilled, for those who shed blood and for those who draw it.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Take this and go to São Paulo tomorrow.
He gestures to the wind-up toy that once belonged to the traitorous officer who stayed at Tuesday's Motel. It's placed beside a G33 syringe and a Flying Arrow M1903 pistol.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Oh, me too? So, if Moldir fails, you want me to use this little toy to get Lopera back?

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: No. You will bring Kimberly back from the Veterans' Residence.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: This is Kimberly's seal. As long as it's in your possession, she cannot disobey you.
A succubus cannot resist the will of whoever holds her contract item.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Bring her back peacefully, if possible.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Of course, Father.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: I will do as you wish.
Instructions given, the admiral leaves.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Right then, Moldir. Let's get started.
He whistles, signaling the guards to begin their massacre.
The sound of gunshots echos through the holding cell.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: What's going on out there?
No one answers.
The guard has already left. Lilya frowns.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Is the base under attack?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: By whom? The Manus has no reason to launch a frontal assault.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The Apostles Brotherhood? No, that's even less likely.
She immediately dismisses the idea.
Holding Cell

items.speaker: Prison Guard
items.text: Get out! Quick, comrade!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Are we under attack?

items.speaker: Prison Guard
items.text: Just take your stuff and go!
The guard hands Lilya her weapons just as the rebels catch up.

items.speaker: Zeno Rebel
items.text: More enemies over here!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Comrade!
Amidst the chaos, the guard has been shot in the leg. Lilya goes to help, but the rebels are closing in fast.
There's no time.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Damn!
Another damnable choice, but this time there's no time to hesitate.

items.speaker: Prison Guard
items.text: Lieutenant Moldir asked me to help you. Take care—

items.speaker: Prison Guard
items.text: Aaah!
With a running start, Lilya leaps onto her Red 38 and takes off into the air, bursting through the rebels and leaving them choking on her exhaust.
First, the bright light of the outdoors hits her; second, the stench of gunpowder and death.
Zeno Base
Traitors and loyalists.
Under the sun, their blood glimmers just the same.
It's plain to see now that their blood paints the courtyard.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Kill them all!

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: No. Recall your troops and assemble.
The remaining loyalists are fleeing. There's no need to pursue them any further.
Ptolemy reluctantly passes on the order.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: All hands, assemble!

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: The bloodshed stops here.
An unceremonious end to the battle. The rebels have formed a new kind of blood brotherhood now.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Moldir, time to head to São Paulo.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Forgive me for asking, Father, but what if Lopera refuses to come back?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Oh, Moldir, if it's too much for you to bear, I'd be happy to go and see our dear little sister for you.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: No need. This is my mission. I will get her to come back.
The two of them are still linked via the tracker button.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: There will be no alteration of the mission. Ptolemy, retrieve Kimberly.
The order is non-negotiable. Ptolemy and Moldir board their boats and head to their respective destinations.
TO BE CONTINUED…
